notes.title: New Skin and Achievements Balance
notes.content:
Happy October, Fruit Salad players!

[h3]Achievements[/h3]
This update brings a balance pass for the fruit-matching achievements. The numbers were a bit too high for the later fruits and have been reduced dramatically. You should get the achievements upon starting the game if you meet the new thresholds.

The following achievements have been tuned:
[list]
[*] Mandarin Madness! - 1000 - 750
[*] Orange Overload! - 1000 -> 500
[*] Apple Apocalypse! - 1000 -> 350
[*] Lemon Lunacy! - 1000 -> 250
[*] Peach Pandemonium! - 750 -> 150
[*] Pineapple Problems! - 500 -> 100
[*] Honeydew Hoopla! - 250 -> 50
[/list]

[h3]New Skin[/h3]
It's time for billiards! ...sort of.

The new Drop Pockets skin (featuring: Marble, D20, Golf ball, Cue ball, 8 ball, Pinball, Crystal ball, Magic 8 ball, Basketball, Dodgeball, and Bowling ball) is now available to everyone.

This new skin is inspired by Drop Pockets, the billiards roguelike developed by Fruit Salad's very own artist, SkeletalGadget!

Drop Pockets has strategic, physics-based billiards gameplay where you go up against Pool Sharks who don't play by the rules. If you're interested, then you can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3005620/Drop_Pockets/]wishlist it here[/url]!

notes.title: Fruit Salad Update 2024-02-16
notes.content:
[b]Build 1.0.02162024[/b]

This update includes a fix for the leaderboards, a QOL change for players who like to play in windowed mode, and two new skins!

[h3]Skins[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Skin - Tropical (Featuring: Blueberry, Raspberry, Kiwi, Starfruit, Lime, Pomegranate, Grapefruit, Dragon Fruit, Coconut, Durian, Jackfruit)
[*] New Skin - Pren's Reward (granted when earning the Pren's Challenge achievement)
[/list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Window size and position are now saved when not in fullscreen mode.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a clipping issue with the friend's leaderboard.
[/list]

notes.title: Fruit Salad Update 2023-12-18
notes.content:
[b]Build 1.0.12182023[/b]

We hope everyone is having a great holiday season so far! This update brings some small bug fixes and includes a couple of new features in that you can now select the audio and display device from the settings screen!

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added audio device selection to settings.
[*] Added display device selection to settings.
[*] The game will now pause automatically when the window loses focus.
[*] Increased the visible score size on the leaderboards.
[*] The elapsed game time now always shows on the finish screen to show how long you played.
[/list]
[h3]Arcade[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where a power-up fruit would show its default face when matched.
[/list]

notes.title: 'Tis the season for Christmas updates!
notes.content:
This update brings a new skin system to Fruit Salad which we plan to leverage for FREE skin updates in the future, and the first of these is available right now. The Christmas skin!

You can find this new feature under Settings, just click the Skins button!

[b]Build 1.0.12012023[/b]

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new skins system.
[*] Added the Christmas skin.
[/list]

notes.title: Fruit Salad Update 2023-11-25
notes.content:
[b]Build 1.0.11252023[/b]

This update includes bug fixes for some outstanding issues impacting users such as memory usage and a problematic texture issue on integrated GPUs such as laptops or NUC devices. These should (hopefully) be resolved now. 

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Lowered texture memory requirements.
[*] Fixed texture issue affecting users on integrated GPUs.
[*] Removed mouse screen confinement.
[*] Game music now does a quicker rotation through the available songs.
[*] Added new setting to disable screen transitions.
[*] Adjusted bounciness of fruits.
[*] Increased responsiveness of mouse aiming.
[*] Increased keyboard and controller aim speed.
[/list]
[h3]Arcade[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where fruit would not fall until jostled.
[*] Added popup text showing points gained from a bomb or rotten match.
[/list]
[h3]Daily Salad[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Daily Salad remaining time display.
[*] Fixed Daily Salad not resetting when restarting a game.
[/list]
